provenance_summary.source_records: Six distinct CDSE discovery sources and six actual PC sources.
provenance_summary.identity_difference_explanation: Source identities/support and all 24 XML hashes/lengths are unchanged. M58 slices were UNAVAILABLE/METADATA_INVALID without accepted header/metadata; M61 slices are AVAILABLE with validated header/metadata and metadata SHA-256. Those stable state fields change slice fingerprints, then group/retrieval identities. Equality was not forced.

limitations: Live readiness is proved only for these six frozen sources at the current AS-201 metadata/access boundary.
RAW_GRD_AMPLITUDE metadata readiness does not prove calibrated backscatter, noise-removal correctness, oil detection or AS-202 readiness.
ThermalNoiseCorrectionPerformed is false in all six accepted metadata summaries; no noise correction was applied.
Footprint support is not raster pixel support, oil area, biological/chemical truth or an intake-safety assessment.
Observed noise bounds/cardinalities establish facts for these sources; no optionality or broader provider/schema rule is inferred.
No VH access, ZIP, image-block/pixel read, SAR scientific transformation or risk scoring occurred.
Offline test success cannot override a live failure; M58 remains historical FAIL despite the later M61 PASS.

canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(semantic, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False); stable arrays; execution times, engineering gate timings, preservation summaries and new commit SHA excluded.
